Sentence (English): So far the dishwasher works without any problems, HOWEVER, because of the installation process I will never order another appliance from Costco ever again.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher works, but installation was a nightmare ] || ---------------- || So far the dishwasher works without any problems, HOWEVER, because of the installation process I will never order another appliance from Costco ever again. Here is an itemized summary of what happened to me: 1) I order it and have to set up delivery/installation a month out, which is an inconvenience but acceptable since they let you know up front 2) I verify the installation date three ways, through email response, phone call, and text message, then the morning of delivery installation I get an email saying that they could not reach me and have canceled the installation. 3) I immediately start calling customer server, where they put you on hold until someone can pick or or after approximately 10 minutes they hang up on you and ask you to leave a message and will call you back. They will never call you back and its a completely random chance anyone will pick up. I spent over 2 hours on hold waiting to talk to someone to resolve the issue. 4) I finally get through and they said they couldn't reach me so they canceled the installation (which is a blatant lie since I had specifically taken the day off work and was waiting at home for any kind of notification or for them to show up, and had gotten a text message that morning). After finally reaching someone they agree to "fit me in" and send someone out that afternoon to do the installation. 5) The installation tech gets there, takes one look and says he can't do the installation because the stock discharge hose is too short. The installation tech didn't have a longer one on hand and he made me purchase it separately. 6) I ask the tech to reschedule me 2 days later at 8 am. He plugs it into his phone and says a tech will be there. 7) no tech shows up after an hour passes of the agreed upon time, so I start calling customer service again. 3.5 hours on hold later and no one answers. So I call a different costco number from the website. Costco spends 15-20 minutes and they cant get ahold of anyone from the installation technicians either. We set up another tentative date the following week, but at this point I have been without a dishwasher for over a month so I keep trying to get in touch with the tech and finally get through. 8) At this point I have been lied to, ignored, and on hold for probably over 5 hours so I demand they have someone take care of the installation that day (especially since this is the second day off work I had to take without pay to accommodate them). The tech gets there much later than the supervisor specified and finally completes the installation. The dishwasher itself seems to be working great but overall, I spent an inordinate amount of time trying to manage this horrible installation company (and unpaid from work time off) trying to get in contact with them only to be lied to and/or dealing with their unpreparedness. As I stated, because of this experience I WILL NEVER BUY ANOTHER APPLIANCE FROM COSTCO EVER AGAIN.

Sentence (English): We got our LDPH7972S nearly two months and boy, is it fantastic!
Comments (English): [ The LDPH7972S is worth every penny!  ] || ---------------- || We got our LDPH7972S nearly two months and boy, is it fantastic! Actually, \"game changer\" sums it up best. Don't listen to the negative reviews - if you're like us and haven't upgraded your dishwasher in over 10 years, you will be completely awed by how AMAZING this LDPH7972S is in comparison. For starters, it is SO quiet! We never ran our old dishwasher at night, it was so loud. Not this one: we frequently run it on a delay after midnight for time of use savings on our electric bill and we never hear it running! Instead, we're greeted in the morning with sparkling dishes, cups and utensils to be put away. The LDPH7972S does an incredible job of cleaning and drying, especially compared to our old dishwasher. With Finish rinsing agent and quality dish detergent tabs, whatever we wash comes out sparkling clean. We've also found the Night Dry with Dry boost gets everything dry, with the only exception being the bottoms of upside-down coffee mugs or anything else that can collect water if not overturned and/or angled correctly. That's also vast improvement over what we were used to seeing with our old dishwasher. Another feature we like is how easy it is to lower or raise the second and third racks. I could go on about all of the great features of the LDPH7972S, such as the ThinQ app - but suffice it to say that every feature that LG describes on their website about this dishwasher are spot on and work just as described. But there are a couple of incredible features that might go unnoticed in other reviews, so we will mention them here. First, the LDPH7972S is a sleek and beautifully designed dishwasher that instantly upgraded our kitchen and forever transformed our experience with dishwashing. Second are the LED lights, both on the inside of the dishwasher as well as the external LED display that appears near the top center of the door when the machine is powered on. These latter two features are game-changers. Being able to see clearly inside the machine upon opening the door is obviously wonderful, and the exterior LED display is pure, high-tech sorcery. See our uploaded photo of the external LED: I can't stop marveling at how it magically appears without there being any hint of a display screen in the stainless-steel door. Thanks to this LED display, you'll always know the time remaining on the selected wash cycle. It then displays “End” when done, so you'll never have to open your dishwasher to find out if it's really done. We love doing our dishes with the LDPH7972S and you will, too!

For starters, it is SO quiet! We never ran our old dishwasher at night, it was so loud. Not this one: we frequently run it on a delay after midnight for time of use savings on our electric bill and we never hear it running! Instead, we're greeted in the morning with sparkling dishes, cups and utensils to be put away. The LDPH7972S does an incredible job of cleaning and drying, especially compared to our old dishwasher. With Finish rinsing agent and quality dish detergent tabs, whatever we wash comes out sparkling clean. We've also found the Night Dry with Dry boost gets everything dry, with the only exception being the bottoms of upside-down coffee mugs or anything else that can collect water if not overturned and/or angled correctly. I could go on about all of the great features of the LDPH7972S, such as the ThinQ app - but suffice it to say that every feature that LG describes on their website about this dishwasher are spot on and work just as described. But there are a couple of incredible features that might go unnoticed in other reviews, so we will mention them here. First, the LDPH7972S is a sleek and beautifully designed dishwasher that instantly upgraded our kitchen and forever transformed our experience with dishwashing. Second are the LED lights, both on the inside of the dishwasher as well as the external LED display that appears near the top center of the door when the machine is powered on. These latter two features are game-changers. Being able to see clearly inside the machine upon opening the door is obviously wonderful, and the exterior LED display is pure, high-tech sorcery. See our uploaded photo of the external LED: I can't stop marveling at how it magically appears without there being any hint of a display screen in the stainless-steel door. Sentence (English): I have been using the w30 dishwasher for a while and it feels very good.
Comments (English): I have been using the w30 dishwasher for a while and it feels very good. I bought the Haier w30 after reading dishwasher reviews online. The main thing I like is that the w30 saves electricity and water. This dishwasher can be connected to the APP. It can be controlled remotely and can also set the dishwashing mode, which is particularly convenient because the kitchen space is small and there is no way to make it embedded. During installation, the installer can only install it on the kitchen counter. It just so happens that the w30 can be embedded or placed outside. At that time, I saw The reviews of w30 are all embedded in the audience. I didn’t see the expected comments and pictures. I was worried during the installation. After installation, I felt more satisfied with the embedded effect because when I looked at the arrangement of dishes and chopsticks online, I found that the placement It takes 20 to 30 minutes to put the dishes and chopsticks in place, and this is the first time to use a dishwasher, not to mention the placement time. The built-in dishwasher cabinet is placed in a bent position, which is definitely uncomfortable for the waist, and it does not need to be placed on the countertop. Bending over is awesome.

Sentence (English): I picked this model for the set of features offered and the pricing on a holiday sale.
Comments (English): [ Good dish washer for the price, on sale. ] || ---------------- || I picked this model for the set of features offered and the pricing on a holiday sale. I'd seen a similar model, but not this exact one, in the store and it seemed reasonable. Instructions for install were adequate, and were available online before purchase, which included listings for optional items (3rd tray, wifi dongle) and required additional items (hose/power kit). My only real complaint is that the sound batting shipped with the product is so laughably thin that it may as well not have been included. I have sheer curtains that have more mass than the batting for this product. It was also not clear that this model does not have at least 2 wheels, but instead has 4 adjustable hex feet which double as holding bolts to it's shipping frame. These are used both for height adjustment and balancing the device. For the price point, it's a reasonable unit and does it's job. I will note though that with the plastic tub and door, the whole unit is super light. While it feels cheep and light because of this, it is rather sturdy, having reasonable aluminum framing internally where needed.
